Consider the system
$$\dot{x}=x(1-x)-\alpha xy, \quad \dot{y}=\beta y(1-y)-\gamma xy$$
with parameters $$\alpha=1.2,\ \beta=0.9,\ \gamma=1.1.$$  
(a) Find all equilibrium points in the real plane.  
(b) Compute the Jacobian at each equilibrium and classify stability using eigenvalues.  
(c) Include a phase portrait plot showing trajectories and equilibrium points for $$x,y\in[0,2].$$
